description: SOUND EFFECTS (SFX) from words with Stable Audio Open — SOUND DESIGN and FOLEY for game audio, apps and video: impacts, whooshes, door slams, footsteps, UI blips, creature and sci-fi sounds, ambiences ("rain on a tin roof", "busy café"), risers, drum one-shots. A one-shot hit ("punchy house kick", "snare with a short room", "a riser into the drop"), a loop on the tempo grid ("glitchy percussion"), or a texture ("vinyl crackle", "rain"). kind picks which (hit | loop | texture); omitted, the server reads it off the words. Don't put a tempo in a hit's prompt — tempo words make it write a loop. Wrong tool for a part with notes (doseedo_render_midi) or a piece of music (you write it; doseedo_render_score plays it). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (typically 15–40 s) → audio URLs (pre-signed: curl -OJ <url>, no auth header, valid 24 h). Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

bpm.description: Tempo a loop is cut to (default 120).

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds. Default: 2 s for a hit, 4 bars at bpm for a loop, 8 s for a texture.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

kind.description: hit = one sound (0.5–10 s), loop = 1–4 bars tiled at bpm, texture = a bed. Default: read off the prompt.

prompt.description: What it sounds like, e.g. "punchy house kick drum, single hit" or "dusty vinyl crackle". ≤ 300 characters.

time_signature.description: Meter a loop is cut to, e.g. "4/4" (default).

name: doseedo_generate_sound
title: Generate sound effects (SFX & foley)
